signal_text: Gumroad's help center article on Getting Paid states that seller payout method depends on the country in which the seller is physically located; if direct deposit is unavailable in that country, payouts occur via PayPal; and if PayPal is also unavailable in that country, there is currently no way to pay the seller.
subject_exact: Gumroad seller payout method determination by country with no alternative if PayPal unavailable
local_qualifiers: in which you are physically located
extraction_notes: Payout layer (seller receiving funds). PayPal is fallback for non-direct-deposit countries. 'Right now' signals potential future change. Countries not enumerated. Page undated.
